target_hf_delta: shared pooled HF residual -> HF heads
target_hf_spatial: per-band spatial HF maps -> residual (content collapse, rejected)
target_hf_subband: per-band pooled HF residual (current best)
target_hf_subband_texture: subband + stationary texture stats (conservative alternate)
target_hf_subband_ablate_residual: causal inference ablation confirming residual value
target_hf_subband_scale_*: residual amplification trades content for off-style
target_hf_subband_nomem: removing style memory weakens frontier
target_hf_subband_memres: explicit memory subtraction weakens frontier
target_hf_multitoken: stationary-stat tokens via attention (rejected)
target_hf_subband_deep_energy: deeper residual + RMS bound (rejected)
target_hf_subband_film_head: pure target-HF FiLM into main HF heads (rejected)
target_hf_subband_basis: low-rank content-derived residual basis (rejected)
target_hf_subband_pairstats: current-target HF discrepancy statistics (rejected)
target_hf_subband_diraux: direct residual-direction auxiliary loss (rejected)
target_hf_subband_timewindow: inference-only early/late residual windows (rejected)
target_hf_subband_mixer: cross-orientation pooled-code mixing (rejected)
target_hf_subband_current_delta: target-current pooled HF code delta (rejected)
target_hf_subband_affine_delta: scale+shift residual (rejected)
target_hf_subband_wct_direction: analytic WCT-stat direction residual (rejected)
target_hf_subband_memdrop: training-only style-memory token dropout (rejected)
target_hf_subband_tasm: time-aware subband modulation (round2, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_ldb: learned direction basis (round2, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_isot: image-specific style tokens for cross-attention (round2, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_mrsc: multi-resolution subband codes (round2, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_isot_mrsc: combined ISOT+MRSC (round3, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_gated: content-dependent spatial gate on residual (round3, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_dynamic_pw: target-style dynamic pointwise convolution residual (round3, rejected vs best)
target_hf_subband_ft10: 10-epoch fine-tune from brk_a_ll03_10ep (round4, overtrains and degrades vs 6-epoch)
target_hf_subband_scratch_5ep: train from scratch 5 epochs (round5, improves content but loses style vs fine-tune)
target_hf_subband_scratch_10ep: train from scratch 10 epochs (round6, test whether longer co-evolution recovers style while keeping content gain)

phase_anchored_hf: Round7 phase-anchored HF transport (h_tilde=iFFT(|F(h_s)|*exp(j*angle(F(h_c))))), content phase + style amplitude, HH head re-enabled after phase alignment, initialized from brk_a_ll03_10ep

phase_anchored_hf_v2: Round7 v2 latent-space phase-anchored (FFT on full latent 32x32 instead of subbands 16x16), fixes shift sensitivity but results identical to v1 — translation invariance was NOT the root cause
ll_wct: Round8 LL subband WCT (full covariance matching) alpha=0.3 — WORSE than AdaIN, full covariance introduces more content distortion
latent_blend: Round8 latent-space target blending gamma=0.15 — extra style injection hurts DINO-S, content degradation cancels style gain
adain_scale_sweep: Round9 endpoint AdaIN scale sweep (0.0/2.0/3.0) — AdaIN=2.0 is Pareto optimal, 3.0 crashes, inference params cannot break ceiling
pixel_wct: Round9 pixel-space WCT post-processing (RGB 3x3 covariance matching, strengths 0.3/0.5/0.7) — NEW direction, all prior work was latent-space, DINOv2 evaluates in pixel space
